name: xBlast
rootCause: The full-chain Web3 ecosystem xBlast, built inside Telegram, disclosed on Twitter that it had been hacked. The attacker transferred XBL tokens from its project's main wallet address and sold them for approximately 22 ETH. xBlast's proposed solution is to deploy a new XBL token and restore liquidity, promising fair compensation for all losses.

descriptions.text: The full-chain Web3 ecosystem xBlast, built inside Telegram, disclosed on Twitter that it had been hacked. The attacker transferred XBL tokens from its project's main wallet address and sold them for approximately 22 ETH. xBlast's proposed solution is to deploy a new XBL token and restore liquidity, promising fair compensation for all losses.

xBlast suffered a hot wallet key compromise on Arbitrum on April 9, 2024, enabling unauthorized XBL token transfer and sale. Approximately $84,500 was lost, with subsequent team measures to deploy a new token and compensate users. The project's main wallet private key controlling XBL on Arbitrum was compromised, allowing unauthorized outgoing transfers and sale of tokens.
